observationQuartet.violationStatement: the adopted inclusive view-relative slice-length law (len(bv.toOpenArray(b, e)) == e - b + 1) demands length 4 for (b=1, e=4) on the pinned fixture; the pinned subject observation is 3 — the template (libp2p/utils/bytesview.nim:18-19) computes v.data.toOpenArray(v.rpos + b, v.rpos + e - b), subtracting the start offset twice (actual length e - 2b + 1 = e - 1)
